mkdir -p .git/hooks && cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Run mypy on all Python files in src/
if command -v mypy >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    mypy src/**/*.py
    RESULT=$?
    if [ $RESULT -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "Mypy failed. Commit aborted."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "mypy not found. Skipping type check."
fi
EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
git init && git add .git/hooks/pre-commit src/py.typed && git commit -m 'release: v1.0.0'
